greeting: Hi {name}! I am the library assistant. Ask me how anything here works.
fallback: I am not sure about that one. Try asking about borrowing, due dates, the game, your account or settings, or open the [Help page](/help).

student: How do I borrow a book?
How do I play the game?
staff: How do I approve a request?
How do I add a book?
How do I post an announcement?
How do I make someone staff?

entries.answer:
To borrow a book:
- Open [Discover](/catalog) and find it (search or filter).
- Click the book, then **Request to borrow**.
- It is reserved for you and a **ticket with a QR code** appears in [My books](/borrowing) and in your email.
- Walk in to the library within **{pickup_days}** and show the ticket at the desk. If you do not pick it up in time, the request is cancelled.

You can have up to {max_loans} books requested or borrowed at once.

**Reserved** means someone already requested the last free copy and staff have not handed it over yet. **All borrowed** means every copy is out on loan. Both update live, on the website and in the game, so check back soon or ask staff when it is due back.

Loan periods: {loan_rules}. The days start when you pick the book up; your due date is on your ticket in [My books](/borrowing).

Late books are fined {fines}, counted every weekday (not weekends or holidays) until you return the book at the library desk.
Open [My books](/borrowing), find the request under **Now** and press **Cancel**. The copy goes back on the shelf for others. You can only cancel a request that staff have not approved yet.
You can have up to {max_loans} books requested or borrowed at the same time. Return one or cancel a request to free a slot.
Use [Discover](/catalog). Type a title, author or genre, then narrow it with **Subject** and **Availability** (for example *Free now*). Click a book to read its summary.

Check [My books](/borrowing): **requested** means waiting for staff, **borrowed** means it is yours until the due date. The bell at the top right tells you when something is approved, declined or returned.

Forgot it? On the sign-in page choose **Forgot your password?**, enter your email and we will send a 6-digit code. Type the code, choose a new password and you are done (the code works for 15 minutes; **Resend code** unlocks after 60 seconds). Already signed in? Change it in [Profile](/profile) under *Password*; you will need your current password.

After 3 wrong passwords for an email, sign-in locks for 1 minute, then 3, 5, 10, 15, 30 and 60 minutes if it keeps happening, with a live countdown. Wait it out, or use **Forgot your password?** (a reset lifts the lock).
Press **Join** on the home page, pick a username (it will also be your name in the game), fill in your details and accept the terms. Then sign in.
Your username is also your name in the game, so it is fixed. If it really needs changing, ask library staff.

Open [Profile](/profile). **My details** has your photo, phone, course, major and year level. **My activity** shows your borrowed and returned books, books read, and a timeline. **Password** changes your password.

Open [Game](/arcade) and press **Enter the game**. It runs right inside the website with your account, so there is no separate sign-in and your username is your name. Use W A S D to walk, the mouse to look and E to use things. On a phone, use the on-screen joystick.
In the game every player has their name above their head with a small label: **Student**, **Staff** or **Admin**, so you can tell who works at the library.
Books you request in the game are reserved on the website too (and the other way round). The stock is shared, so a book someone else reserved shows as reserved in both places.
In the game press **T** or **Enter** to chat with other readers in the room. Messages show the sender's name and Student or Staff label.
Walk to a computer in the game and open Chess. You can play the computer (easy, intermediate or hard) or make an online room and share the code with a friend.
Open [Settings](/settings) to pick **Library Blue**, **Cozy Cream** or **Night Reading**, and to turn on **Reduce motion** if the animations bother you.
Read the [Terms](/terms) and the [Privacy notice](/privacy). If the terms change you will be asked to accept the new version the next time you sign in.
For anything I cannot fix, ask the library staff at the desk. You can also check the [Help page](/help). If something looks broken, tell staff what page you were on and what you clicked.
Opening hours are posted in [Updates](/announcements). If you cannot find them there, please ask the library staff.

Open **Circulation** in the sidebar. Under **Requests** press **Approve** to lend the book (the student is notified and the due date is set) or **Decline** with an optional reason. Under **On loan** press **Returned** when it comes back.

Go to **Books**, press **Add a book** and fill in the details (you can upload a cover). Use **Edit** to change copies, **Archive** to hide a book from the catalog (only when it has no open loans). Only admins can delete a book for good.
Open **Announcements**, press **New**, write a title and message and keep *Show to everyone* ticked to publish. Untick it to save a draft.

Open **People**. Search for the person. Admins can change a role (student, staff, admin) from the dropdown. Staff and admins can **Disable** or **Enable** an account. Nobody can change their own role.
**Dashboard** shows live numbers (titles, requests, loans, overdue, most borrowed). **Reports** downloads CSV files for loans, books and people.

Admins find these under **Site settings**: loan length, books per student, registration open or closed, allowed email domains, the game status (open, maintenance, closed), a site-wide notice and the assistant. The people behind the library on the About page are fixed and cannot be edited from the panel.
The bell (top right) shows your newest notices. Open [Notifications](/notifications) to read everything, mark items as read or delete them.
For your safety you are signed out after 30 minutes without activity, or after 8 hours in total. Just sign in again and you will return to where you were.
In [Profile](/profile), open **My activity**, then the **Returned** tab and press **Mark as read** on a book. It moves to **Books read**.

Some staff tools need a permission from an administrator: **Students** (student profiles, notices), **Game** (edit details, host), **Settings**, **Reports** and **Audit trail**. If a section is missing from your sidebar, ask an admin to grant it. Admins give permissions under **Staff**.

Email a borrower from **Circulation** or the **Dashboard** with the **Email** button on an overdue loan. With the Students permission you can also open a student and press **Send notice** (overdue notice, due date reminder or a general message) and preview the letter first.

When you request a book you get a **ticket with a QR code**, in [My books](/borrowing) and in your email. Walk in to the library within **{pickup_days}** and show it at the desk: staff scan it to hand the book over, and your ticket then shows the due date. If the QR will not scan, staff can type the pickup code printed under it.
Check your spam folder first, and that the email on your [Profile](/profile) is correct. You do not need the email: open [My books](/borrowing) and press **Show QR** on your request.
